title: Master's / Lane-Change ROI for Educators
description: Calculate the NPV, payback period, and break-even lane bump for a K-12 teacher pursuing a master's degree or additional graduate credits — net of tuition, opportunity cost, employer tuition assistance, and Teacher Loan Forgiveness (ESEA §1059c). Includes optional pension FAS uplift modeling.
regulatory_citations: ESEA §1059c — Teacher Loan Forgiveness: $5,000 standard / $17,500 highly qualified math, science, or special ed (statutory since 2004, verified 2026)
